title: Sales By Customer Sales Type filter looks as designed
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • You are signed in as a user with the "Admin" role at {Location-A}.
    For example: {Location-A} is Staging Heavy Duty - 9919.
  • The design canvas is open in another tab at page 5, boards 5.1 and 5.2.
    For example: the canvas is https://claude.ai/artifact/8MHqwyffAYtqZ6EccS5RUm.
  • Starting screen: Reports > Sales By Customer is open in a desktop browser window 1440 px wide at 100% zoom.
  • If any record above is missing, mark this test Blocked: "setup not done".
custom_steps:
1. Compare the closed filter with board 5.1.
  2. Open it and compare with board 5.2.
custom_expected:
Expected results

  • Step 1: it reads "Sales Type: All Sales" where "Product Type" used to be, as in the picture.
  • Step 2: options "Part Sales" and "Service Sales", both ticked, as in the picture.

Source — where this behaviour comes from
Epic SV-10890; story SV-11272 (Story 8, Filter both sales reports by Sales Type); PRD "Splitting Sales Representatives", Confluence 919928833, version 8 (14 Oct 2026, Chris Ward), S8-R6, S8-R7, S8-R8, read 19 Oct 2026. Claude design canvas "Splitting Sales Representatives" (https://claude.ai/artifact/8MHqwyffAYtqZ6EccS5RUm), export read 19 Oct 2026, page 5, boards 5.1 and 5.2, used for the picture to compare against.   • S8-R6: “On Sales By Customer, the filter labeled "Product Type" today is labeled "Sales Type".”
